history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration ensure recruitment on as wide a geographical basis as possible of resident coordinators and resident coordinator pool members.
history.administration_response: As at 1 April 2025, 58 per cent of the resident coordinators originated from programme countries (compared with 41 per cent pre-reform, in 2018), a historic high. In addition, 62 nationalities were represented, compared with 57 pre-reform. The percentage of resident coordinators from non-programme countries steadily decreased to 42 per cent (compared with 60 per cent pre-reform, in 2018), while the percentage of resident coordinators from other geographical regions, notably Africa, gradually increased. For example, the percentage of resident coordinators from Africa increased to 34 per cent, up from 22 per cent pre-reform, in 2018. As at 1 April 2025, 51 per cent of resident coordinator pool members were from programme countries, compared with 36 per cent pre-reform, in 2018. Furthermore, 67 nationalities are represented among resident coordinator pool members. This attests to the efforts of the Development Coordination Office to increase geographical diversity in the resident coordinator pool.
history.board_assessment: Given that, as at 1 April 2025, 42 per cent of resident coordinators originated from non- programme countries and 49 per cent of resident coordinator pool members were from non-programme countries – ratios that both reflect a high concentration of resident coordinators from such countries – the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: In paragraph 496 of its report, the Board recommended that the Administration ensure recruitment on as wide a geographical basis as possible of resident coordinators and resident coordinator pool members.
history.reference_raw: Report of the Board for the year ended 31 December 2022 8
history.sg_progress: With reference to the Board’s latest comments in annex I of A/80/5 (Vol. I), the Development Coordination Office is pleased to demonstrate that this recommendation has been implemented, supported by the following metrics: (a) As of 1 August 2025, 63 nationalities are represented among resident coordinators, compared with 57 prior to the reform, meaning that approximately one in three Member States is represented. The Administration considers this to reflect a wide geographical basis; (b) The proportion of resident coordinators from non-programme countries has declined steadily to 42 per cent, from 60 per cent in 2018 (pre-reform), while resident coordinators from programme countries now account for 58 per cent, up from 41 per cent in 2018 and marking a historic high; (c) Representation from other geographical regions, in particular Africa, has also increased. For example, the percentage of resident coordinators from Africa has risen to 32 per cent, from 22 per cent pre-reform. The Administration therefore requests the closure of this recommendation by the Board.
